verdict.rationale: Shopify POS's own help docs include an article titled "Using Shopify POS offline", so there is a first-party offline mode. Nothing in the pack says card payments can be taken offline or that transactions are stored and forwarded once connectivity returns. The Tap to Pay material actually describes contactless payments over WiFi or cellular connectivity. Missing for 10: evidence that card payments work offline, a documented store-and-forward queue that syncs on reconnect, offline limits and risk details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns
